sentences.text: Present: Mr. Ravinder Singh Chandel, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Ajit Sharma, Deputy Advocate General for the respondent-State.
Notice.
Mr. Ajit Sharma, Learned Deputy Advocate General, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the sole respondent.
Let status report be filed in two weeks.
List the matter on 31st May, 2024.

2. The bail petitioner [Ajesh Kumar] has come up before this Court, under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, seeking pre-arrest bail, originating from FIR No.15 of 2018, dated 19.10.2018, registered at Women Police Station, BCS, New Shimla, [H.P.], under Sections 376,
354A, 341, 451, 511 and 506 of Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Women Police Station, BCS, New Shimla
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The case set up by Mr. Ravinder Singh Chandel, Learned Counsel, is that the bail petitioner [Ajesh Kumar], had moved bail application before the Learned Sessions Judge, Shimla (HP), on 26.10.2018 for pre-arrest bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the same was granted on 30.10.2018.

The operative part of the order dated .
30.10.2018 reads as under:-
10.

"Considering all these facts, the police is not able to make out a case, at this stage,
for custodial interrogation.

As such, the interim order dated 27.10.2018 passed in favour of bail-applicant is made absolute subject to following conditions:-
i) That the bail applicant shall made himself available for interrogation as and when called by the investigating officer in this case.

ii) That the bail applicant shall not inducement threat or promise to any r person acquainted with facts of case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to Court or to any police officer.
iii) That the bail applicant shall not commit an offence similar to offence of which he is accused.
iv) That the bail applicant shall not leave the country without the prior permission of the investigating officer or the Court.
11 The application is accordingly disposed off.

It is made clear that bail applicant shall move regular bail before the concerned Court as and when report under Section 173 of the Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: The police authorities are at liberty to move application for cancellation of this order, if the bail applicant violated any of the conditions imposed upon the accused by this Court.
13. Nothing observed hereinafter shall be taken to be any expression to this Court on the merits of the case.
The findings so given are confined to the disposal of the present bail application.
Bail application disposed of.
Be consigned to the record room, after due completion.
Announced and signed in the open Court today this 30th day of October, 2018.

(-Sd-) Sessions Judge, Shimla, H.P.
4.
Consequent upon the registration of FIR, the trial commenced before Learned Additional Sessions .

Judge, (Fast Track), Special Court [Rape/POCSO], Shimla, H.P. and Learned Trial Court has passed the order on 01.05.2024, (Annexure P-2, Colly) to seek Report as to whether the bail petitioner [Ajesh Kumar] has applied for regular bail, in terms of Condition No.11 of the bail order dated 30.10.2018, after the Challan/Final Police Report under Section 173 of the Code of Criminal Procedure was filed against the accused on 19.10.2018, (Annexure P-2).

The orders dated 01.05.2024 (Annexure P-2) reads as under:-
"01.05.2024
Present: Mrs. Sangeeta Justa Mishra, Ld. Public Prosecutor for the State.
Ms. Amita Thakur, Advocate vice to Ms. Ambika Kotwal, Advocate, for the prosecutrix.
Accused not present.
Sh. Ashwani Dhiman, Advocate for the accused.
Sh. Ashwani Dhiman, Advocate for the accused Ajesh has moved an application seeking personal exemption of the accused, which is considered and allowed, for the reasons stated therein for today only.
Arguments partly heard.
Be put up for further arguments on 20.05.2024 as prayed.
In the meantime office to report about regular bail of the accused."

(-Sd-) Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Special Court (Rape/POCSO), Shimla, H.P."
5.

sentences.text:
Mr. Ravinder Chandel, Learned Counsel for the .
Ajesh Kumar vs State Of H.P. on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39689364/
2 bail petitioner, submits that the Condition No.11 in the bail order dated 30.10.2018, (Annexure P-1)
which limits the grant of bail till the date of filing of Challan/Police Report before the Magistrate on 01.02.2019, (Annexure P-2, Colly) is not in terms of the mandate of law in Sushila Aggarwal versus State-NCT Delhi, (2020) 5 SCC 01 and Criminal Appeal No. 272, 273 of 2021 titled as Dr. Rajesh Pratap Giri Versus State of U.P. an Anr.
6.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal versus State-NCT Delhi, (2020) 5 SCC 01
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Rajesh Pratap Giri Versus State of U.P. an Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above facts and circumstances, coupled with the fact that the FIR was registered on 19.10.2018 and the investigation is complete long back and even the challan stands presented before the Magistrate coupled with the fact that Condition No.11 in orders dated 30.10.2018, (Annexure P-1) is contrary to law in case of Sushila Aggarwal and Dr. Rajesh Pratap Giri (supra) this Court is inclined to grant interim protection to the bail petitioner [Ajesh Kumar], by way of an interim bail,
till the next date of hearing, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) In the event of the arrest of the bail petitioner, he shall be released on bail on execution of his personal bond in the sum of Rs.40,000/-, with one surety, in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the SHO, Police Station, Women Police .

(ix) It is clarified that violation of any of the conditions imposed hereinabove, shall entail cancellation of bail automatically; and (x) The Respondent(s) are at liberty to move .
Ajesh Kumar vs State Of H.P. on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39689364/
3 this Court for modification or cancellation of bail, if the circumstances, so necessitate or in case of violation of any of the conditions mandated herein.
